```renyi
module inventory.reorder_report

import std.console as console
import std.environment as environment
import std.filesystem as filesystem
import std.json as json

public type Product
  purpose: A product record from the input file.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
end

public function main()
  purpose: Read products from a JSON file and print items that need reordering.
  needs console, filesystem.read, environment
  example: main()

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path be arguments.first() otherwise crash with "missing input file path"
  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail

  let low_stock_products be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock ascending
    collect product
  end

  for each product in low_stock_products
    console.print("{product.name} {product.stock} {product.reorder_level}")
  end
end
```

```renyi
module inventory.reorder_report

import std.console as console
import std.environment as environment
import std.filesystem as filesystem
import std.json as json

public type Product
  purpose: A product record from the input file.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
end

public function main()
  purpose: Read products from a JSON file and print items that need reordering.
  needs console, filesystem.read, environment
  let path be environment.arguments().first otherwise crash with "missing input file path"
  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise crash with "cannot read input file"
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise crash with "invalid JSON input"

  let low_stock_products be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock ascending
    collect product
end

  for each product in low_stock_products
    console.print("{product.name} {product.stock} {product.reorder_level}")
  end
end
```
